user.title: Set up Sunset
user.description: Configure the evening, night and morning colour temperature schedule.

data_description.evening_time: When the colour temperature starts shifting towards the night value.
data_description.night_time: When the night colour temperature is reached.
data_description.bed_time: When brightness is lowered; leave empty to keep brightness unchanged.
data_description.morning_time: When the colour temperature returns to the daytime value.
data_description.day_color_temp: Colour temperature during the day, in Kelvin.
data_description.night_color_temp: Colour temperature during the night, in Kelvin.
data_description.night_brightness: Brightness applied after bed time, from 0 to 255.
data_description.brightness_enabled: Disable to leave the brightness of your lights unchanged.
data_description.excluded_entities: Lights Sunset should never control; temporary exclusions use the services instead.
